title: Node status requests
summary: Requests that return a node's hostname and role.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text:
| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| [GET](#get-all-nodes-status) | `/v1/nodes/status` | Get the status of all nodes |
| [GET](#get-node-status) | `/v1/nodes/{uid}/status` | Get a node's status |

sections.title: Get all node statuses
sections.text:
GET /v1/nodes/status

Gets the status of all nodes. Includes each node's hostname and role in the cluster:

- Primary nodes return `"role": "master"`

- Replica nodes return `"role": "slave"`

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [view_node_info](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#view_node_info) |

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request

	GET /v1/nodes/status

#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |

sections.title: Response
sections.text:
For each node in the cluster, returns a JSON object that contains each node's hostname, role, and other status details.

If a maintenance snapshot exists due to an in-progress or improperly stopped [node maintenance](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/clusters/maintenance-mode) process, the response includes a `maintenance_snapshot` field.

sections.title: Get node status
sections.text:
GET /v1/nodes/{int: uid}/status

Gets the status of a node. Includes the node's hostname and role in the cluster:

- Primary nodes return `"role": "master"`

- Replica nodes return `"role": "slave"`

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [view_node_info](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#view_node_info) |

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request

	GET /v1/nodes/1/status


#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |


#### URL parameters

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| uid | integer | The node's unique ID. |

sections.title: Response
sections.text:
Returns a JSON object that contains the node's hostname, role, and other status details.

If a maintenance snapshot exists due to an in-progress or improperly stopped [node maintenance](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/clusters/maintenance-mode) process, the response includes a `maintenance_snapshot` field.

#### Example JSON body

sections.title: Status codes
sections.text:
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| [200 OK](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.2.1) | No error |
| [404 Not Found](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.4.5) | Node UID does not exist |
